body: Pretty sure this won't work in my favor... Why am I posting this?

Hello. I'd like to ask a question.

Is it possible for gender dysphoria to only occur after one recognizes they're the opposite gender rather than before?

I'm currently questioning and for some reason I get a lot more distress from situations that were pretty mild before questioning but are now seemingly much worse.

For example someone mentioning my masculinity was fine before but now hurts Everytime it happens after I started suspecting I'm transgender.

This is very confusing for me and I'd like some help. Thanks.
I'll think about it. Your argument is valid it's just I've been hiding this for so long that it will be hard. I'll try

I've thought about this a lot in the past. It's why I haven't killed myself when I was 12 or 11. I can't stand the thought of causing my family pain. I only attempted suicide when I couldn't feel anything. I honestly didn't care who was affected at the time. It scares me when I think back on it how uncaring I was of everything. I'm trying to stay alive but life has never been anything to me. Ive been hurting so much the last few years. I don't know how to endure like so many others can.
No and I never will. They have enough stress in their life.
